about_item: Fluffy Orthopedic Dog Bed – When my dog finally crashes after playtime, I want them sinking into ultra-soft long plush—not a thin mat. This calming orthopedic dog bed (great for medium & large breeds) helps anxious pups settle faster for all-night, joint-friendly sleep.

Curved Bolster Sofa Bed – Three-sided bolsters hug like a sofa, giving wraparound security and gentle neck support—perfect for curl-up sleepers or head-on-pillow loungers. It’s the cozy large dog couch / puppy sofa comfort they choose over our furniture every time.

Supportive Egg-Crate Foam Base – Orthopedic egg-crate foam distributes weight evenly to relieve pressure on hips and elbows—no more bottoming-out pads for big dogs or seniors. Works as a kennel or crate cushion and as an indoor sleeping pad; durable support from puppy to XL.

Modern & Durable Design – We love our living room looking put-together. The stylish bouclé (boucle) fabric blends with modern décor like a chic dog sofa bed—so you won’t feel the need to hide a bulky pet lounger when guests arrive. Durable, cozy, photo-ready.

Easy Care & Practical Details – Real life = shedding, drool, and spills. The removable, machine-washable cover plus waterproof inner liner protect the orthopedic foam; the non-slip bottom keeps the bed in place on wood or tile. Ideal for multi-dog homes and daily use.

authors_reviews.title: Dogs love it, warm and cozy through the long, cold winter!
authors_reviews.text: I ordered this to replace a flatter memory foam dog bed for one of my three dogs in our office because I wanted something that had a back/sides and would block a little more draft in the very cold winter. All three dogs take turns sleeping in this and seem to love it. It was compressed in the packaging but took it's shape fairly quickly after unpacking. The material is extremely soft - like a very soft/cozy blanket. The support seems adequate compared to the other beds they have. We have a steel shop/office building with concrete floors for our business so it was important to me to find something that would elevate them enough off the floor and also be warm and comfortable as they age. With an area rug underneath, this definitely fits the bill and of course I'd love if it were less expensive, I'm satisfied with the value for what it cost.
authors_reviews.author: BoondocksGlam

authors_reviews.title: Fantastic Dog Bed
authors_reviews.text: I cannot say enough about this bed. My dog is 9 and he lost his 10 year old brother recently. He's had a difficult time sleeping as he was on the schedule of his aging brother. Prior to purchasing the bed, he woke at 3am at the latest. He would also cry at night. Now, he sleeps like a baby. He is a mastiff mix so I ordered the largest bed and he fits it perfectly. It loosely hugs him and provides the support a large, aging dog needs. Great quality, very thick, washable and cover is easily removed (comes with an additional liner as well), functional, and roomy. The largest size takes up lots of space but so does the largest size dog. I'm happy with this purchase.
authors_reviews.author: Jamie Fox

other_countries_reviews.title: Miorun Anti-Anxiety Dog Bed for Medium Dogs
other_countries_reviews.text: I've been using the Miorun Anti-Anxiety Dog Bed for my medium-sized dog for about three weeks now, and overall, I'm pleased with it. Indeed I have two small cockapoos who have slept together in it. Although unfortunately the one has decided to bit open the zip around it. .The bolstered sides do provide that cozy, enclosed feeling the dogs enjoy. The memory foam is comfortable enough and removable, washable cover is convenient and has held up well through two washes so far, maintaining its khaki color without significant fading. Would I recommend it? Yes, with enthusiasm. It's a good dog bed that does what it promises well, especially if your dog likes nestling into raised edges.
